basis: Installed Stardew Valley 1.6.15 Farmer and shirt pixels plus the Fashion Sense 7.5.0 Scale-2 jacket contract.

blendBudget.rule: Use extra cells for coverage, silhouette, construction, layering, and clustered shade transitions before seams or micro detail.

benchmarkRefinement.basis: Recurring quality tendencies measured and visually inspected across the attached benchmark packs; no benchmark pixels, layouts, or designs are encoded.
rules: Use darkest contour as silhouette anchors, not an automatic uniform ring.
Allow short lit shoulder-edge runs while keeping neck, side, underarm, and hem anchors dark.
Use one dominant construction gesture per view and subordinate secondary seams.
Bias light clusters consistently instead of lighting symmetric panels equally.
Avoid full-width lower shadow bands; terminate hem shadows in attached corner clusters.
Spend additional logical cells on diagonals, overlap depth, and controlled transitions rather than additional colors.
Evaluate shirt grammar separately from large animated accessory grammar.
